# Implementation Plan: Config Save overwrites the generated file (no path picking)

**Branch**: `main` | **Date**: 2026-11-16 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: specs/040-config-save-in-place/spec.md (FR-001..008; user accepted the local link 2026-11-16)

## Summary

A small local save service of the tool serves each request's `config.html` at
`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/r/<request_id>/<token>/` and accepts Save from that page: the page sends its state (JSON),
the service rebuilds the page from the data block of the file on disk + the new state and replaces
`<request folder>/config.html` atomically. `isim_config` starts the service on demand (detached process, exits after
idle) and M1 gives the link. Pages opened from disk keep the 038 Save (picker / download); the 038 reader is unchanged.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12 (repo `.venv`), vanilla JS in the existing page assets
**Primary Dependencies**: Python stdlib only (`http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer`, `secrets`, `json`); no new package
**Storage**: `<request>/config.html` (038 format) + `<request>/_work/config_token` + `~/.aedt_copilot/config_service.json`
**Testing**: offline unit tests with the service on port 0 in a thread (fake request registry, `tests/unit/_isim_fixture`);
browser check on a board1 copy request (quickstart)
**Target Platform**: Windows 11, Chrome / Edge (any browser works: plain `fetch` to 127.0.0.1)
**Performance Goals**: Save round trip < 2 s for a 15 MB page (server rebuilds from disk: one parse + one build)
**Constraints**: listen on 127.0.0.1 only; write only `<folder of a registered request>/config.html`; no path from the page
**Scale/Scope**: one service per PC, a handful of open requests

## Constitution Check

| Principle | Status |
|---|---|
| I Gates in code | Unchanged: saving the config approves nothing; `isim_config_check` / `isim_go` gates stay. |
| II Data safety | Only the tool-generated `config.html` of a registered, not read-only request is replaced (temp file + `os.replace`); stale page (file on disk newer) refused (409), never silently overwritten. No user file touched. |
| III Defaults | New machine setting `config_port` (optional, `config.yaml`, default 17880) — machine config, not a cut rule. |
| IV Guides | M1 text changes (link) generated by the tool; guide `interface_sim` §0 mentions the link + fallback. |
| V Regression | Offline suite; `tests/config_flow_check.py` (board1 copy) still PASS; browser Save check on a copy. |
| VI Windows / encoding | UTF-8 read / write with explicit encoding, `newline="\n"` as `flow.config`; detached start like `run.py` (DETACHED_PROCESS). |
| VII Contracts | `contracts/config-save.md`: `serve.ensure`, `serve.page_url`, HTTP endpoints, `save_state`; inputs validated (CopilotInputError / HTTP 4xx). |
| VIII Thin layers | Logic in `interface_sim/config/serve.py`; CLI `config-serve` = argument parsing + call. |
| IX Stable interface | `isim_config` result gains `config_url` (added key, nothing removed); M1 keeps the file path line. |
| X Catalog | No new MCP tool. CLI gets one command (`config-serve`, internal) → CLI golden ADDED list. Workflows unaffected. |

## Design

1. **`interface_sim/config/serve.py`** (new)
   - `Service` = `ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port))`, handler routes:
     - `GET /health` → `{"service": "aedt_copilot config", "version": __version__, "pid"}`
     - `GET /r/<rid>/<token>/` → current `<request>/config.html` from disk (`text/html; charset=utf-8`, `Cache-Control: no-store`)
     - `POST /r/<rid>/<token>/save` (JSON `{state, base_rev}`) → `save_state(...)` → 200 `{path, saved_at, rev}` /
       400 invalid state / 403 bad token / 404 unknown request / 409 stale or read-only / 415 not JSON
     - `POST /shutdown` with the service secret from `config_service.json` (used by `ensure` on version change)
   - `save_state(rid, token, state, base_rev)`: `R.load(rid)` (registry → folder; page never gives a path), token
     compare (`secrets.compare_digest`), parse the disk file (`page.read_file`) → `(rid', disk_state, data)`;
     refuse when `rid' != rid`, `data.readonly`, `rev(data, disk_state) != base_rev`; validate state channels = data
     channels and every folder with `model.check_folder` + uniqueness (038 page rules); `state.saved_at` = server time;
     `page.build(data, state)` → write `config.html.tmp` → `os.replace`. → new rev.
   - `rev(data, state) = f"{data['built_at']}|{state.get('saved_at') or ''}"`.
   - idle timer: exit after `IDLE_S` (8 h) without requests.
   - `ensure(log)`: read `~/.aedt_copilot/config_service.json`; `GET /health` → ours and same version → port; other
     version → `/shutdown` then start; nothing / not ours → start detached `python -m aedt_copilot config-serve
     --port <p>` trying `config_port .. +9`; wait ≤ 5 s for health. Failure → `None` (caller falls back, M1 old text).
   - `token_for(req)`: `<work>/config_token` (32 hex, created once per request).
   - `page_url(req, port)` → `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/r/<rid>/<token>/`.
2. **`page.py` / `flow.page_data`**: data gains `built_at` (ISO time of the build). Old pages without it → rev uses "".
3. **`page.js` `saveCfg`**: if `location.protocol` is `http:` and the path matches `/r/<rid>/<token>/` → `fetch(base +
   "save", {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: {state: S, base_rev: BASE}})`;
   200 → message `Saved to <path> (<time>) — tell Claude you are done.`, `BASE = rev`; 409 → `Not saved: <reason> —
   reload the page.`; 400 → server message; network error → `Cannot reach the tool — saving with the browser instead.`
   then the 038 picker / download. `file:` → 038 path unchanged. Initial hint text: link mode says `Save writes
   <folder>\config.html directly.`
4. **`flow.config`**: after writing the page: `port = serve.ensure(log)`; `url = serve.page_url(req, port)` if port;
   result `config_url`; `answer_md = A.m1(path, url)`.
5. **`answers.py`**: `m1(path, url=None)`: with url → `Link config: <url> — mở link, điền tên folder, bấm Save rồi trả
   lời *xong*. (File: `<path>`)` / `Config link: <url> — open it, fill the folder names, press Save, then reply
   *done*. (File: `<path>`)`; without url → 038 text.
6. **CLI** `config-serve --port N` (parser + commands) → `serve.main(port)`.
7. **Guide** `interface_sim` §0: M1 has a link; the file path is for reference; fallback when Claude was closed.

```

aedt_copilot/interface_sim/config/flow.py       ensure + url + M1
aedt_copilot/interface_sim/config/answers.py    m1(path, url)
aedt_copilot/interface_sim/config/assets/page.js  save via fetch in link mode

config.yaml                                     config_port (comment, optional)
guides/interface_sim.md                         §0 link
tests/unit/test_config_serve.py                 NEW
tests/unit/test_thin_layers_014.py (CLI golden) ADDED command
```

## Complexity Tracking

| Item | Why needed | Simpler alternative rejected |
|---|---|---|
| Local HTTP service | Only way to overwrite the file with zero dialogs (browser security) | Remember the picked file handle: still one picker per page (user: no picking) |
| Detached process | Must outlive one tool call; one per PC for all sessions | Thread inside the MCP server: dies with the session that started it; port clash between sessions |
